findings.text: Token heights accepted as DS token-semantics, not local drift: no local CSS; tokens control.height=44px/control.textarea=88px match declared web/app.css values; ds-token-drift PASS (20 checks). Actual 45px/92px comes from min-height + line-height/padding/border (rows=3); exact 44/88 requires DS 1.0.2. Recorded in design-impact residual item 5 (control 45px, textarea 92px).

Offline banner gap is now 16px at both breakpoints (search bottom 421 -> banner top 437 at 390; 394 -> 410 at 1200); the merged double border is gone. Confirmed in export-390-offline.png / export-1200-offline.png.
design-impact.md reissued for DS 1.0.1: ds_release 1.0.1, digest 4e0ef105…, constraint =1.0.1, manifest 1.0.1 sha dbc2983b…; stale 22px/15px residual claims replaced with the 1.0.1 alignment.

prototypes/v7/manifest.json created: v7, DS 1.0.1 + digest + code web/app.css, 16 exports (8 states x 390/1200 incl. offline-zero); all files exist; .fig sha256/size match .fig-cache (88e91fae…, 57099 B). Sharing the .fig with v6 is justified by the absence of any DS 1.0.1 visual delta.

No <h1>: hierarchy starts at .brand 19.2px and label 16px/600; font.h1=22.4px is confirmed only by the CSS rule, not by render. Accepted because the shipped screen has no page heading; residual tracked for s22a/UX.

Five utility classes (.brand/.user-name/.note-text/.notes-search-row/.muted) are recorded as GAP-4 registry-omission (blocking=false, accepted) in feature and unit design-gaps.json; design-impact residual item 1 lists them. They are release web/app.css classes, not local instances.
notes-empty remains without role/aria-live; the loading->empty transition is silent. Accepted as matching the shipped app and tracked for s22a.
no-results still has two live regions (count aria-live=polite and notes-search-empty role=status aria-live=polite). Accepted non-blocking duplication.
Disabled search is visually indistinguishable from active (no input:disabled style), including the new empty state. GAP-2 accepted; no local CSS; DS 1.x should add a visual disabled state.
Stale references removed: state-matrix declares Notebook DS 1.0.1; GAP-1 workaround no longer says body 15px; design-gaps/component-refs/ds.lock are on 1.0.1 digest 4e0ef105….
Disabled Add remains 2.21:1 (white on #84B0F4) and reads as an active primary. WCAG 1.4.3 does not apply to disabled; accepted with a DS suggestion for an explicit disabled primary style.
Primary button widths differ: retry is 120px at 1200 and full-width 332px at 390, while Add is always full-width (566/332). Accepted non-blocking inconsistency.

UI-02 side effect: the offline banner got class note-item notes-search-empty, using the search-empty state class as a spacing utility (margin-top:16px). Visually correct, no local CSS, but semantically overloaded; recommend moving the banner into .notes-list or adding a DS spacing utility.
prototype-review.json is now present in prototypes/v7, so manifest.review.path resolves and the approved verdict is backed by a real review artifact.

offline-zero shows both the offline banner and the base empty message «Добавьте первую выше» while Add/search/delete are offline-disabled. Accepted copy residual (state described in state-matrix); recommend offline-specific copy.

Error is role=alert aria-live=polite, internally contradictory (role=alert is implicitly assertive). Intent is correct; cleaner would be role=status aria-live=polite. Accepted non-blocking ARIA cleanup.

Independent re-check by a session that is not the author or prior UI reviewer: all 16 v7 exports reproduce from proto.html + web/app.css with 0 pixel diff in Chromium 1.64; no local <style>/style=/external CSS; roles/labels/aria-live verified; clear/retry/offline-check/delete transitions work; contrasts AA; no horizontal overflow. Provenance note: .fig-cache is fixed-name, but sha256/size match the manifest and identity with v6 is explained by the absence of a DS 1.0.1 visual delta.

findings.text: empty now disables the search field (searchDisabled includes empty) with native disabled + aria-disabled=true + aria-describedby=notes-empty, matching web/app.js searchBlocked(notes.length===0).

Accepted product residual, re-rated minor. Offline search stays disabled per spec §3.3 with aria-disabled + aria-describedby + offline placeholder; the copy overstates a network dependency for a client-side filter (AOD-2). Bounded to the transient offline state; tracked for s22e.
Prototype per-row delete is disabled via formDisabled in loading/error/offline/offline-zero and active in idle/results; product-code parity tracked for s22a/s22e.

?state=offline-zero renders «Нет сети — нет загруженных заметок.» + base empty message, disabled search, hidden count/list/clear. 8 states x 2 viewports = 16 exports; proto.json and state-matrix describe it.
«Проверить сеть» now simulates a successful re-check by returning to idle instead of reloading the same offline URL. The still-offline branch is not simulated (acceptable for a state prototype).
Clear -> idle, Retry -> idle, per-row delete removes the row and updates the results count, offline-check -> idle. Remaining focus/Add/Logout inertness is accepted as a state-prototype limitation.
Error region is role=alert aria-live=polite, matching spec §3.2 and web/index.html.

Active artifacts are on DS 1.0.1 (state-matrix, proto.json, design-impact, ds-pin/ds-lock/refs, digest 4e0ef105…); spec/core.md and visualized-brief.md remain historical 1.0.0 snapshots. 1.0.1's only CSS delta is an explicit body font-size, so there is no visual drift.

findings.text: Accepted GAP-2 residual for DS 1.x: disabled search has no visual disabled treatment (only button:disabled is styled); the pixel comparison confirms the empty export is visually unchanged after disabling.
Offline banner stays a .note-item card with an interactive button inside role=status; reads like another note row and wraps a control in a live region. Recovery CTA is clear; no local CSS.
At 390 the clear control is a separate full-width 44px block under the field (stacked .notes-search-row), detached from the query and as heavy as the composer action; label-in-name passes.
Accepted minor, now recorded: state-matrix notes the prototype label/placeholder divergence from web/index.html and drops the no-autofocus claim.

Verified count semantics (Найдено 2 / 0, hidden on empty query, polite live region); classes exist in web/app.css 1.0.1 with no local CSS; offline copy avoids a persistence promise; language split follows AOD-6; 16 exports cover 8 states. v6 comparison: 10/14 unchanged; 2 empty frames differ by 2 px at delta 1; 2 offline frames differ as intended (disabled deletes + banner spacing).
Deleting the last visible match in results now goes to no-results (not empty), matching state-matrix and web/app.js renderNotes.
offline-zero shows «Добавьте первую выше» while Add is offline-disabled; accepted copy residual mirroring current app behavior (offline banner + notes-empty, form disabled), tracked for s22a.
The composer textarea is now disabled in loading/error/offline/offline-zero (noteText.disabled = formDisabled), matching web/app.js syncFormState.

State-per-render limitation: the search input is not live-wired in the static prototype (typing does not filter); web/app.js implements live filtering. Recorded in state-matrix so the query->results step is not read as a live interaction.
